scripts.build: node init && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && node scripts/build-auth-test-site.mjs && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests website-companion scripts/*.mjs *.ts *.json index.html README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests website-companion scripts/*.mjs *.ts *.json index.html README.md
scripts.test:google: npm run build && node scripts/build-auth-test-site.mjs && playwright test tests/browser/google-sign-in.spec.ts
scripts.build:companion: node init && tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.companion.config.ts
